Role skills hold each method; reference skills (backend, frontend, azure, ai-foundry, rag-patterns, database) supply domain conventions without deciding. Rules of record in guidence/GUIDE.md; MCP slots (GitHub, Azure, Figma, database, documentation) documented in mcp/README.md. Works in Claude Code (/plugin install) and claude.ai (per-skill ZIP).
